deals.travelWindow: Oct 3 – Nov 14, cheapest early-Oct and mid-Nov pairings
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant's one-way fares dropped to $60 and a round-trip pairing on Nov 12–14 runs as low as $96 — the cheapest verified fare of the week, with the Everglades under an hour away and the free Sun Trolley covering the rest.
deals.soloWhy: The free Sun Trolley links the beach and Las Olas without a car, and the lit beachfront promenade stays comfortable for a solo evening walk.

itinerary: Day 1 — Check in near the beach, promenade walk at sunset, Las Olas for dinner and people-watching.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Shark Valley's flat 15-mile Everglades bike loop, alligators sunning along the canal, back for a Riverwalk stroll.
Day 3 — Bonnet House gardens in the morning, water taxi hop to Las Olas for lunch before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Sun Trolley covers downtown, Las Olas, and the beach; a rental car is worth it only for the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: The beachfront or Las Olas — both walkable to restaurants, the promenade, and water taxi stops.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 20 – Nov 26, cheapest late-Oct and Thanksgiving-week pairings
deals.whyRanked: Southwest's calendar still shows $59 one-ways on Oct 24, 26–29 and 31, with a round trip as low as $96 for Nov 26 travel — tied with Fort Lauderdale for cheapest fare, but Assateague's 2.5-hour drive and a lower solo score keep it second.
deals.soloWhy: The Inner Harbor and Fells Point are flat and walkable with plenty of counter-seating for solo dining, linked by a water taxi so a car is never needed downtown.

itinerary: Day 1 — Inner Harbor on arrival, National Aquarium, water taxi to Fells Point for oysters at a counter stool.
Day 2 — Fort McHenry in the morning, Federal Hill overlook for the skyline, dinner back in Fells Point.
Day 3 — American Visionary Art Museum, Lexington Market crab cakes before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Inner Harbor, Fells Point, and Fort McHenry are covered by the water taxi and a short walk or rideshare; no rental car needed unless heading to Assateague.
guide.stayArea: Fells Point or the Inner Harbor — walkable, close to the water taxi and restaurants.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue's one-way floor eased to $70 and a round trip on Oct 26–27 or Nov 13–14 still prices around $107–140 — pricier than the Baltimore/Fort Lauderdale tie, but the Metro plus free Smithsonians keep DC's solo score the highest of the five.
deals.soloWhy: The Metro reaches nearly every monument and museum, the Mall is safe to walk solo well into the evening, and the Smithsonians are free.

highlights: Tidal Basin loop past the Jefferson Memorial
Eastern Market on a weekend morning
Great Falls Park overlook on the Potomac
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, drop bags, Tidal Basin loop at golden hour, dinner near Eastern Market.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Shenandoah: Skyline Drive to Hawksbill summit, back for an H Street dinner.
Day 3 — Great Falls Park towpath walk in the morning, a Smithsonian of choice before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Metro covers the Mall, museums, and most neighborhoods; a rental car is only needed for Shenandoah or Great Falls.
guide.stayArea: Near a Metro stop on the Orange/Blue/Silver line (Capitol Hill or Foggy Bottom) for the fastest reach to the Mall.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant's calendar prices a Nov 7–14 round trip at $110–118, edging up slightly from last week but still cheap enough to hold a top-5 spot, with the Smokies just 45 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore alone on foot, and the Cosby and Greenbrier entrances to the Smokies are a short solo drive with none of the Cades Cove crowds.

highlights: World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere
Market Square farmers' stalls and street music
South Knoxville's urban wilderness bike/hike trails
Cosby entrance to the Great Smoky Mountains
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, walk World's Fair Park up to the Sunsphere deck for sunset, then dinner on Market Square.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Cosby: Hen Wallow Falls trail, Foothills Parkway overlooks on the way back.
Day 3 — Ijams Nature Center loop in the morning, Market Square farmers' stalls before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable end to end; a rental car is required to reach the national park entrances.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.travelWindow: Oct – early Nov, cheapest October midweek pairings
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue and Southwest both price one-ways from $90, with an October round trip as low as $149 — the priciest of the five this week, but still the cheapest verified fare past the top 4, and Kennedy Space Center's wildlife refuge is under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Theme parks are easy to tackle solo with single-rider lines and mobile ordering, and the Lynx bus plus rideshare cover the rest without a rental car downtown.

highlights: Universal Epic Universe or Islands of Adventure
Winter Park's Park Avenue and Scenic Boat Tour
Merritt Island's Black Point Wildlife Drive
Lake Eola Park sunset loop downtown
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, Lake Eola Park sunset walk downtown, dinner in the Mills 50 district.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Kennedy Space Center and the Black Point Wildlife Drive on Merritt Island, back for a quiet evening.
Day 3 — Morning at a theme park using single-rider lines, Winter Park's Park Avenue for lunch before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is worth it for Kennedy Space Center and Winter Park; the Lynx bus and rideshare cover downtown and the parks otherwise.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Orlando or Winter Park for a quieter, more walkable base than the International Drive tourist strip.
food: Se7en Bites (Southern comfort food, Milk District)
